l-e-e6-b01-02.title: -s ọ̀ na-aga mgbe He na She mgbe niile?
l-e-e6-b01-02.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na verb mgbe He ma ọ bụ She na-anata -s mgbe niile bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e6-b01-02.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe subject bụ He ma ọ bụ She, tinye -s n'ọgwụgwụ verb mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b01-02.s.s1.r.a: plays nwere -s. Ọ dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b01-02.s.s1.r.b: walks nwere -s. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b01-02.s.s1.r.c: likes nwere -s. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b01-02.s.s1.explain: Jiri ụdị ntọala nke ngwaa mgbe okwu dị ka can. N'She can swim., swim enweghị -s.
l-e-e6-b01-02.s.s2.model.0: N'She can swim., isiokwu bụ She ma ngwaa swim enweghị -s, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.

l-e-e6-b01-03.title: A na-eji comma naanị tupu and?
l-e-e6-b01-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na a na-eji comma naanị tupu and bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e6-b01-03.material: Nkwupụta: A comma (,) is used only before and. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b01-03.s.s1.r.b: Comma dị tupu and. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b01-03.s.s1.r.c: Comma dị tupu and. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b01-03.s.s1.r.d: Comma dị tupu and. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b01-03.s.s1.explain: Comma dị n'Yes, I can. dị mgbe Yes. A na-eji comma ọbụna n'enweghị and.

l-e-e6-b01-03.s.s2.model.1: A na-etinyekwa comma mgbe Yes, ya mere ahịrị okwu a bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-e-e6-b01-04.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "the answer to a When question is a clock time" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e6-b01-04.material: Nkwupụta: Azịza ajụjụ na-amalite site na When bụ oge elekere (ọnụọgụ) mgbe niile. Chọta ajụjụ na azịza na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b01-04.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ajụjụ na azịza na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e6-b01-04.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-enye oge 7:30. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b01-04.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-enye oge 12:30. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b01-04.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-enye oge 9 o'clock. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b01-04.s.s1.explain: When na-ajụ banyere oge, ma azịza nwere ike ịbụ ụbọchị nke izu. Last Friday abụghị oge elekere n'ọnụọgụ.
l-e-e6-b01-04.s.s2.model.0: Last Friday bụ ụbọchị nke izu, ọ bụghị oge elekere n'ọnụọgụ, ya mere nkwupụta na azịza When bụ oge elekere mgbe niile adịghị mma.

l-e-e6-b01-05.title: Okwu na-amalite site na un- pụtara mmegide mgbe niile?
l-e-e6-b01-05.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "a word that starts with un- means the opposite" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e6-b01-05.material: Nkwupụta: Ọ bụrụ na okwu na-amalite site na un-, ọ pụtara mmegide nke okwu na-esote un-. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b01-05.s.s1.r.b: Ọ pụtara mmegide nke safe. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b01-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọ pụtara mmegide nke happy. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b01-05.s.s1.r.d: Ọ pụtara mmegide nke fair. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b01-05.s.s1.explain: Un dị n'uncle (onye ikwu, nwanne nna) apụtaghị "mmegide". Ọ bụrụ na ị wepụ un, enweghị okwu cle ọzọ.
l-e-e6-b01-05.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị wepụ un site na uncle, enweghị okwu cle, ya mere un- apụtaghị mmegide mgbe niile.
l-e-e6-b01-05.s.s2.model.1: Uncle bụ onye ikwu, nwanne nna, ya mere ọ na-emegide iwu ihe mmegide.

l-e-e6-b02-01.title: Ahịrịokwu When ọ̀ bụ banyere oge gara aga mgbe niile?
l-e-e6-b02-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "A sentence with When is about the past" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e6-b02-01.material: Nkwupụta: A sentence with When always talks about something that already happened. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b02-01.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ banyere oge gara aga mgbe mgbịrịgba tụrụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b02-01.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ banyere oge gara aga mgbe mmadụ dị afọ ise. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b02-01.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ banyere oge gara aga mgbe oku ekwentị bịara. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b02-01.s.s1.explain: When it rains bụ omenaala maka oge ọ bụla mmiri na-ezo. Ọ bụghị banyere oge gara aga kama ọ bụ present tense.
l-e-e6-b02-01.s.s2.model.0: When it rains, I read at home. bụ omenaala present-tense, ya mere nkwupụta na ọ bụ banyere oge gara aga ezighị ezi.
l-e-e6-b02-01.s.s2.model.1: rains na read na-ekwu banyere omenaala ugbu a, ya mere ahịrịokwu When abụghị banyere oge gara aga mgbe niile.

l-e-e6-b02-02.title: May ọ̀ pụtara ikike mgbe niile?
l-e-e6-b02-02.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "may pụtara naanị ikike" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e6-b02-02.material: Nkwupụta: Ahịrịokwu nwere may na-ekwu "a kwere gị ka ị" (ikike) mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b02-02.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ ikike ịga. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b02-02.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-arịọ ikike ịbanye. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b02-02.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ ikike ịnọdụ ala. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b02-02.s.s1.explain: may na-apụtakwa ohere, dị ka "might be." Ọ na-ekwu na mmiri nwere ike ịzo echi.
l-e-e6-b02-02.s.s2.model.0: It may rain tomorrow. bụ banyere ohere na mmiri ga-ezo, ya mere nkwupụta na may bụ ikike mgbe niile ezighị ezi.
l-e-e6-b02-02.s.s2.model.1: Ọ nweghị onye na-enye ikike, ya mere may n'ahịrịokwu a na-ekwu banyere ohere, ọ bụghị ikike.

l-e-e6-b02-03.title: A na-eji apostrophe naanị n'contractions?
l-e-e6-b02-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "A na-eji apostrophe (') naanị n'contractions" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e6-b02-03.material: Nkwupụta: A na-eji apostrophe (') naanị n'contractions. Chọta ahịrịokwu nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b02-03.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ udi dị mkpụmkpụ nke We are. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b02-03.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ udi dị mkpụmkpụ nke do not. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b02-03.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ udi dị mkpụmkpụ nke She is. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b02-03.s.s1.explain: teacher's na-egosi ịbụ nwe ihe, nke pụtara "nke onye nkụzi." A na-eji apostrophe ọbụna mgbe ọ bụghị contraction.
l-e-e6-b02-03.s.s2.model.0: teacher's pụtara ihe bụ nke onye nkụzi, nke bụ ịbụ nwe ihe, ya mere nkwupụta na a na-eji ya naanị n'contractions ezighị ezi.
l-e-e6-b02-03.s.s2.model.1: The teacher's desk enweghị okwu e mere ka ọ dị mkpụmkpụ, ya mere ahịrịokwu a bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-e-e6-b02-04.title: Azịza nke ajụjụ Who ọ̀ bụ aha mgbe niile?
l-e-e6-b02-04.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "Azịza nke ajụjụ e jụrụ site na Who bụ aha mmadụ" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e6-b02-04.material: Nkwupụta: Azịza nke ajụjụ na-amalite na Who bụ aha mmadụ mgbe niile (okwu dị ka Jin). Chọta ajụjụ na azịza nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b02-04.s.s1.r.a: Aha Max bụ azịza. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b02-04.s.s1.r.b: Aha Lena bụ azịza. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b02-04.s.s1.r.c: Aha Jin bụ azịza. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b02-04.s.s1.explain: Azịza nke Who nwere ike ịbụ otu ìgwè mmadụ, dị ka Our class. Azịza abụghị naanị otu aha mgbe niile.
l-e-e6-b02-04.s.s2.model.0: Our class abụghị aha mmadụ kama ọ bụ otu ìgwè, ya mere nkwupụta na azịza nke Who bụ aha mgbe niile ezighị ezi.
l-e-e6-b02-04.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe ụfọdụ azịza nke Who bụ ọtụtụ mmadụ, ya mere Our class bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-e-e6-b02-05.title: Okwu na-agwụ na -er ọ̀ na-apụta mmadụ mgbe niile?
l-e-e6-b02-05.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "Okwu na-agwụ na -er pụtara mmadụ" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e6-b02-05.material: Nkwupụta: Okwu nke na-agwụ na -er pụtara "onye na-eme ihe" mgbe niile. Chọta okwu nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b02-05.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ onye na-akọ ihe ubi. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b02-05.s.s1.explain: water (mmiri) na-agwụ na -er, mana ọ bụghị mmadụ. -er n'ọgwụgwụ okwu anaghị apụta mmadụ mgbe niile.
l-e-e6-b02-05.s.s2.model.0: water na-agwụ na -er, mana ọ pụtara mmiri, ya mere nkwupụta na ọ pụtara mmadụ ezighị ezi.

l-e-e6-b03-01.title: Ihe e buru ụzọ dee ọ̀ na-eme mbụ?
l-e-e6-b03-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na ihe e buru ụzọ dee na-eme mbụ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (counterexample).
l-e-e6-b03-01.material: Nkwupụta: N'ahịrịokwu, ihe e buru ụzọ dee bụ ihe mere mbụ. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b03-01.s.s1.r.a: E buru ụzọ dee ibili ma mee ya mbụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.

l-e-e6-b04-02.material: Nkwupụta: Can pụtara mgbe niile naanị ike "nwee ike." Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a, ebe a na-eji can n'ihe ọzọ ọ pụtara.
l-e-e6-b04-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị okwu ebe a na-eji can n'ihe ọ pụtara na-abụghị ike.

l-e-e6-b04-02.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-ekwu banyere ike azụ. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b04-02.s.s1.explain: Can I borrow your pencil? na-arịọ ikike ịgbazinye pensụl. Ọ bụghị banyere ike.

l-e-e6-b04-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "a question mark is used only when words like who and what are present" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-e6-b04-03.material: Nkwupụta: A na-eji akara ajụjụ (?) naanị n'ahịrị okwu nwere okwu ajụjụ dị ka who, what, ma ọ bụ where. Chọta ajụjụ na-akwụsị na akara ajụjụ n'enweghị okwu ajụjụ, nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b04-03.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ajụjụ na-akwụsị na akara ajụjụ n'enweghị okwu ajụjụ.
l-e-e6-b04-03.s.s1.r.a: Ọ nwere who. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b04-03.s.s1.r.b: Ọ nwere what. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b04-03.s.s1.r.d: Ọ nwere where. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b04-03.s.s1.explain: Can you swim? enweghị okwu ajụjụ, ma ọ na-ajụ ihe, ya mere ọ na-akwụsị na akara ajụjụ. Ajụjụ a na-aza site na yes ma ọ bụ no na-ejikwa akara ajụjụ.
l-e-e6-b04-03.s.s2.model.0: Can you swim? enweghị okwu ajụjụ, ma ọ na-ewere akara ajụjụ n'ihi na ọ na-ajụ ihe, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.

l-e-e6-b04-04.topic: Otú a na-eji oge ugbu a na-aga n'ihu
l-e-e6-b04-04.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "am/is/are + -ing is something happening now" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-e6-b04-04.material: Nkwupụta: Am/is/are + verb-ing na-ekwu mgbe niile banyere ihe na-eme ugbu a. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.

l-e-e6-b04-04.s.s1.r.b: Ihe na-ada ugbu a. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b04-04.s.s1.r.c: Onye na-ehi ụra ugbu a. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b04-04.s.s1.r.d: Onye na-agụ ugbu a. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b04-04.s.s1.explain: Next week dị ebe ahụ, ya mere ọ na-ekwu banyere atụmatụ ọdịnihu. A na-ejikwa Am/is/are + -ing maka atụmatụ ọdịnihu dị nso.

l-e-e6-b05-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “that always means ‘that one over there’” ziri ezi mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e6-b05-01.material: Nkwupụta: that is always a word that points to “that one over there.” Chọta ahịrịokwu ebe that na-eme ihe ọzọ, nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b05-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu ebe that abụghị okwu na-egosi ihe.
l-e-e6-b05-01.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-egosi nke ahụ n'ebe ahụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b05-01.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-egosi akwụkwọ ahụ n'ebe ahụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b05-01.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-egosi nnụnụ ahụ n'ebe ahụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b05-01.s.s1.explain: That dị n'I think that we can win. abụghị okwu na-egosi ihe; ọ na-ejikọta 'I think' na ihe na-esote.
l-e-e6-b05-01.s.s2.model.0: That dị n'I think that we can win. anaghị egosi ihe n'ebe ahụ kama ọ na-ejikọta ahịrịokwu ahụ, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.

l-e-e6-b05-02.title: Could ọ̀ bụ banyere ikike n'oge gara aga mgbe niile?
l-e-e6-b05-02.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “could only talks about ability in the past” ziri ezi mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e6-b05-02.material: Nkwupụta: could is only used to mean “was able to in the past.” Chọta ahịrịokwu ebe a na-eji could n'ihe ọzọ ọ pụtara, nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b05-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu ebe could abụghị banyere ikike n'oge gara aga.
l-e-e6-b05-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ ihe e mere n'oge gara aga nke enweghị ike ịchọta igodo. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b05-02.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ ikike n'oge gara aga nke ịnwe ike ime ya n'afọ ise. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b05-02.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ ihe e mere n'oge gara aga nke enweghị ike ịhụ kpakpando. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b05-02.s.s1.explain: Could you ~? bụ ụzọ nkwanye ùgwù isi rịọ mmadụ imeghe ọnụ ụzọ. Ọ bụghị ikike n'oge gara aga.
l-e-e6-b05-02.s.s2.model.0: Could you open the door, please? bụ arịrịọ nkwanye ùgwù, ya mere could anaghị apụta naanị ikike n'oge gara aga.
l-e-e6-b05-02.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrịokwu a anaghị akọ akụkọ banyere oge gara aga kama ọ na-arịọ ihe ugbu a, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.

l-e-e6-b05-03.title: A na-ede aha isiokwu ụlọ akwụkwọ mgbe niile n'mkpụrụedemede nta?
l-e-e6-b05-03.topic: Mkpụrụedemede buru ibu maka aha asụsụ
l-e-e6-b05-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “names of school subjects are written in lowercase” ziri ezi mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e6-b05-03.material: Nkwupụta: In English, names of school subjects are always written in lowercase. Chọta ahịrịokwu ebe a ga-ede aha isiokwu n'mkpụrụedemede buru ibu, nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b05-03.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu ebe a ga-ede aha isiokwu n'mkpụrụedemede buru ibu.
l-e-e6-b05-03.s.s1.r.a: art dere n'mkpụrụedemede nta. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b05-03.s.s1.r.c: science dere n'mkpụrụedemede nta. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b05-03.s.s1.r.d: math dere n'mkpụrụedemede nta. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b05-03.s.s1.explain: English bụ aha asụsụ, ya mere ọbụlagodi mgbe a na-eji ya dị ka isiokwu, ọ na-amalite mgbe niile na mkpụrụedemede buru ibu.
l-e-e6-b05-03.s.s2.model.0: English bụ aha asụsụ, ya mere a na-ede ya n'mkpụrụedemede buru ibu ọbụlagodi dị ka isiokwu, nke pụtara na nkwupụta na isiokwu niile bụ mkpụrụedemede nta ezighi ezi.
l-e-e6-b05-03.s.s2.model.1: N'adịghị ka math na science, aha asụsụ na-eji mkpụrụedemede buru ibu, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere nke na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-e6-b05-04.material: Nkwupụta: The answer to a question asked with How many always contains an exact number like 3 or three. Chọta azịza na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e6-b05-04.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ azịza na-enweghị ọnụọgụ doro anya.
l-e-e6-b05-04.s.s1.r.a: Ọ nwere ọnụọgụ 3. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b05-04.s.s1.r.b: Ọ nwere ọnụọgụ three. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b05-04.s.s1.r.d: Ọ nwere ọnụọgụ ten. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-e6-b05-04.s.s2.model.0: There are a lot of books. bụ azịza na-enweghị ọnụọgụ doro anya, ya mere ị naghị aza mgbe niile site n'ọnụọgụ.

l-e-e6-b05-05.title: Mkpụrụedemede ea ọ̀ na-eme otu ụda n'ebe niile?
l-e-e6-b05-05.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “the letters ea always make the same sound” ziri ezi mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e6-b05-05.material: Nkwupụta: The letters ea make the same sound in any word. Chọta ụzọ okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a, ebe ea na-eme ụda dị iche.
l-e-e6-b05-05.s.s1.r.a: Abụọ nwere ụda /iː/. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-e6-b05-05.s.s1.r.d: Abụọ nwere ụda /iː/. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b05-05.s.s1.explain: Ea dị n'bread nwere ụda /ɛ/ ma ea dị n'bean nwere ụda /iː/. Otu mkpụrụedemede na-eme ụda dị iche.
l-e-e6-b05-05.s.s2.model.0: Ea dị n'bread bụ /ɛ/ ma ea dị n'bean bụ /iː/, ya mere ụda dị iche ma nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.

l-e-e6-b06-01.title: So ọ na-apụtakarị 'ya mere' mgbe niile?
l-e-e6-b06-01.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na so na-apụta mgbe niile 'ya mere' ọ̀ ziri ezi mgbe niile, chọtakwa ma kọwaa ikpe ọ na-adịghị ezi (ihe atụ megidere ya).
l-e-e6-b06-01.material: Nkwupụta: so bụ mgbe niile okwu na-ejikọ nsonaazụ, 'ya mere'. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-megidere nkwupụta a, ebe a na-eji so n'ihe ọzọ ọ pụtara.
l-e-e6-b06-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu ebe a na-eji so n'ihe ọzọ ọ pụtara na-abụghị 'ya mere'.
l-e-e6-b06-01.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-ejikọ nsonaazụ nke ihi ụra n'ihi ike gwụrụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b06-01.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-ejikọ nsonaazụ nke ịpụ n'ihi oyi. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b06-01.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-ejikọ nsonaazụ nke ịgba ọsọ n'ihi igbu oge. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e6-b06-01.s.s1.explain: So n'It was so cold today. pụtara 'nke ukwuu' ma na-emesi oyi ike. Ọ bụghị okwu na-ejikọ nsonaazụ.
l-e-e6-b06-01.s.s2.model.0: So n'so cold pụtara 'nke ukwuu' ma na-akọwa oyi, ya mere so anaghị apụta therefore mgbe niile.
l-e-e6-b06-01.s.s2.model.1: N'ahịrịokwu a ọ naghị ejikọ ihe abụọ kama ọ na-emesi ike na oyi na-atụ, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-e6-b02-11.material: I was late. / She was late. / You were late. / They were late. Chọta iwu ahụ ma mezuo We ___ late.

l-e-e6-b02-11.s.s1.explain: Otu onye na-anata was, ma you na ihe karịrị otu na-anata were. We bụ ihe karịrị otu, ya mere ọ bụ were.
l-e-e6-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: A na-eji were na ihe karịrị otu, dị ka You na They, ya mere We bụkwa were.
l-e-e6-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: A na-eji was naanị maka otu onye, ya mere were ziri ezi maka We late.

l-e-e6-b03-12.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ị jụrụ site n'May, ị na-aza site n'may ma ọ bụ may not. Ọ bụ Yes, you may.

l-e-e6-b06-11.s.s1.r.d: Ọ jiri naanị -ing n'enweghị be verb.
l-e-e6-b06-11.s.s1.explain: Verbs na-egosipụta echiche ma ọ bụ mmetụta, dị ka know, like, need, na want, anaghị anata -ing ọtụtụ oge ọbụna mgbe ha pụtara ugbu a.

l-e-e6-b06-15.s.s1.r.a: Ọ gbakwunyere 6 n'18. Ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ agbakwunyere kama ọ bụ ọnụọgụ e mụbara na-anọgide otu.
l-e-e6-b06-15.s.s1.r.b: Ọ gbakwunyere 18 n'18. 2→6→18 na-eto ugboro 3 oge ọ bụla.
l-e-e6-b06-15.s.s1.r.d: Ọ mụbara 18 site na 9. Ọnụọgụ e mụbara bụ 3.
l-e-e6-b06-15.s.s1.explain: 2 → 6 → 18 na-eto ugboro 3 oge ọ bụla. Ya mere Day 4 bụ 18 × 3 = okwu 54.

l-e-e6-b06-15.s.s2.model.1: Iwu bụ imụba ọnụọgụ gara aga site na 3, ya mere 18 × 3 = 54, ma okwu 54 ziri ezi.

l-e-e6-b07-05.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n’ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ahịrịokwu bụ isi n’ederede dị mkpirikpi, jirizie ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nwalee iwu ahụ.
l-e-e6-b07-05.material: Nkọwa 1: Nwamba na-ehi ụra n’anyanwụ. Nwamba na-ehi ụra n’elu akwa. Nwamba na-ehi ụra nke ukwuu. Nkọwa 2: Aṅụ na-arụsi ọrụ ike. Aṅụ na-eme mmanụ aṅụ. Aṅụ na-aga n’okooko osisi. Ahịrịokwu bụ isi bụ nke ikpeazụ na Nkọwa 1, ma nke mbụ na Nkọwa 2. Chọta iwu ahụ.
l-e-e6-b07-05.s.s1.prompt: Nkọwa 3: Lee na-egwu mmiri. Lee na-agba ọsọ. Lee na-agba ịnyịnya igwe. Lee na-arụsi ọrụ ike nke ukwuu. Kedu nke bụ ahịrịokwu bụ isi?
l-e-e6-b07-05.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-ekwu naanị banyere igwu mmiri. O kpuchighị ịgba ọsọ na ịnya igwe.
l-e-e6-b07-05.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-ekwu naanị banyere ịgba ọsọ. O kpuchighị ihe omume ndị ọzọ.
l-e-e6-b07-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-ekwu naanị banyere ịnya igwe. O kpuchighị ihe omume ndị ọzọ.
l-e-e6-b07-05.s.s1.explain: Ahịrịokwu bụ isi abụghị maka ebe o dị, kama ọ bụ maka ikpuchi ahịrịokwu ndị ọzọ niile. Lee na-arụsi ọrụ ike nke ukwuu. jikọtara ihe omume atọ ahụ.
l-e-e6-b07-05.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrịokwu bụ isi n’ihe odide ọ bụla na-ekpuchi ahịrịokwu ndị ọzọ niile; ya mere na Nkọwa 3 ọ bụ Lee na-arụsi ọrụ ike nke ukwuu., nke jikọtara igwu mmiri, ịgba ọsọ na ịnya igwe.
l-e-e6-b07-05.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrịokwu bụ isi nwere ike ibu nke mbụ ma ọ bụ nke ikpeazụ; ihe dị mkpa abụghị ebe ọ dị kama ihe ọ na-ekpuchi. Ọ bụ ya mere “na-arụsi ọrụ ike nke ukwuu” ji bụrụ isi okwu.

l-e-e6-b01-17.goal: Tụ anya ọnụọgụ okwu ọhụrụ a ga-amụta n'izu 4, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e6-b01-17.material: Ị na-amụta okwu ọhụrụ 8 n'ụbọchị ma na-amụ ihe ụbọchị 5 n'izu. Tụ anya ọnụọgụ okwu ị ga-amụta n'izu 4.
l-e-e6-b01-17.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ e mụtara n'otu izu, ọ bụghị izu 4.
l-e-e6-b01-17.s.s1.r.b: 100 bụ ọnụọgụ e mụtara n'ụbọchị 12~13 na 8 n'ụbọchị.
l-e-e6-b01-17.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ e mụtara n'ụbọchị 100 na 8 n'ụbọchị. Ọ dị ọtụtụ nke ukwuu.
l-e-e6-b01-17.s.s2.model.0: N'otu izu ọ bụ 8 × 5 = okwu 40, ya mere n'izu 4 ọ bụ ihe dị ka okwu 160.
l-e-e6-b01-17.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ okwu 40 n'izu, ugboro 4, ya mere ị na-amụta ihe dị ka okwu 160.

l-e-e6-b01-18.title: Oge ọrụ mgbe ụlọ akwụkwọ na-agwụ
l-e-e6-b01-18.goal: Tụ anya oge ọrụ atọ ahụ na-agwụ, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e6-b01-18.material: Ọrụ mgbe ụlọ akwụkwọ na-amalite na 3:30. Nke mbụ, anyị na-agụ nkeji 25. Mgbe ahụ, anyị na-ede nkeji 40. N'ikpeazụ, anyị na-ekwu okwu nkeji 15.
l-e-e6-b01-18.s.s1.prompt: Kedu oge ziri ezi maka ọrụ niile ịgwụ?
l-e-e6-b01-18.s.s1.o.a: Ihe dị ka elekere 4, n'ime otu awa
l-e-e6-b01-18.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ naanị nkeji 30 mgbe 3:30. Ọrụ ndị ahụ dị ogologo karịa.
l-e-e6-b01-18.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ na-ewere oge ọrụ dị ka nkeji 120. Ngụkọta bụ nkeji 80.
l-e-e6-b01-18.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ na-agbakwunye awa 3. Ọ dị oge nke ukwuu.
l-e-e6-b01-18.s.s2.model.0: 25 + 40 + 15 bụ nkeji 80, ya mere ịgbakwunye ya na 3:30 na-enye ihe dị ka 4:50.
l-e-e6-b01-18.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-ewe otu awa na nkeji 20, ya mere ọ na-agwụ tupu elekere 5.

l-e-e6-b01-19.goal: Tụ anya ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu because ụmụ akwụkwọ na-ede, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e6-b01-19.material: Ụmụ akwụkwọ 24 nke ọ bụla na-ede ahịrịokwu because 2. Bọọdụ nwere ohere maka ahịrị ahịrịokwu 45. Tụ anya ma ohere zuru ezu.
l-e-e6-b01-19.s.s1.o.a: Ihe dị ka 48, ohere ezughị ezu
l-e-e6-b01-19.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụrụ na onye ọ bụla dere 1. Ọ bụ 2 nke ọ bụla.
l-e-e6-b01-19.s.s1.o.d: Ihe dị ka 100, ohere ezughị ezu
l-e-e6-b01-19.s.s1.r.d: 100 bụ ihe dị ka ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụrụ na onye ọ bụla dere 4. Ọ dị ọtụtụ nke ukwuu.
l-e-e6-b01-19.s.s2.model.0: Mmadụ 24 na-ede 2 nke ọ bụla, ya mere 24 × 2 = 48, nke karịrị ahịrị 45.

l-e-e6-b01-20.goal: Tụ anya ịgụ nkeji 45 n'ọsọ nke peeji 5 n'nkeji 10, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e6-b01-20.material: Enwere m ike ịgụ peeji 5 n'nkeji 10. Tụ anya ọnụọgụ peeji enwere ike ịgụ n'nkeji 45 n'ọsọ a.
l-e-e6-b01-20.s.s1.r.a: Nkeji 45 dị ogologo karịa nkeji 10 nke ukwuu. Peeji 4 dị ole na ole nke ukwuu.
l-e-e6-b01-20.s.s1.r.b: Peeji 9 bụ ọnụọgụ e gụrụ n'ihe dị ka nkeji 18.
l-e-e6-b01-20.s.s1.r.d: Na peeji 5 n'nkeji 10, peeji 50 bụ ọnụọgụ e gụrụ n'nkeji 100.
l-e-e6-b01-20.s.s1.explain: Nkeji 45 bụ okpukpu 4 na ọkara nke nkeji 10, ya mere 5 × 4.5 = peeji 22.5, ihe dị ka peeji 22.
l-e-e6-b01-20.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ peeji 5 n'nkeji 10 ọ bụla ma nkeji 45 bụ ihe dị ka okpukpu 4 na ọkara nke nkeji 10, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka peeji 22.
l-e-e6-b01-20.s.s2.model.1: Nkeji 40 na-enye peeji 20, ma peeji 2~3 ọzọ na-agbakwunye n'nkeji 5, ya mere ọ dị ntakịrị karịa peeji 20.

l-e-e6-b02-16.goal: Tụọ ụbọchị ole ọ ga-ewe iji mụta kaadị okwu niile, họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e6-b02-16.material: Kaadị okwu dị 100. Ị na-amụta kaadị 6 kwa ụbọchị. Tụọ ụbọchị ole ọ ga-ewe iji mụta ha niile.
l-e-e6-b02-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụ ọgụgụ ụbọchị dabara adaba?
l-e-e6-b02-16.s.s1.r.a: Ụbọchị 6 bụ ihe dị ka kaadị 36. Nke ahụ erughị kaadị 100.
l-e-e6-b02-16.s.s1.r.c: Ụbọchị 60 bụ ihe dị ka kaadị 360. Oge ahụ dị ogologo nke ukwuu.
l-e-e6-b02-16.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụ ọgụgụ ụbọchị ma ọ bụrụ na ị mụta kaadị 1 kwa ụbọchị.
l-e-e6-b02-16.s.s1.explain: 100 ÷ 6 dị n’etiti 16 na 17, ya mere ọ ga-ewe ihe dị ka ụbọchị 17.
l-e-e6-b02-16.s.s2.model.0: Kaadị 6 ugboro 17 na-eme kaadị 102; ya mere ọ ga-ewe ihe dị ka ụbọchị 17.

l-e-e6-b02-18.material: Ederede ahụ nwere okwu 400. Mgbe a na-elegharị ngwa ngwa, ị na-agụ okwu 200 n’ime nkeji 1; mgbe a na-agụ nke ọma, ị na-agụ okwu 80 n’ime nkeji 1. Tụọ oke oge ịgụ ya.
l-e-e6-b02-18.s.s1.prompt: Kedu oke oge ịgụ dabara adaba?
l-e-e6-b02-18.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ dị ogologo nke ukwuu. Ọbụna ma ị gụọ okwu 80 n’otu oge, ọ ga-ewe naanị nkeji 5.
l-e-e6-b02-18.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ dị ogologo maka okwu 400.
l-e-e6-b02-18.s.s1.r.d: Iji gụọ okwu 400 n’ime nkeji 1, ọsọ gị ga-abụ okwu 400.
l-e-e6-b02-18.s.s1.explain: 400 ÷ 200 = nkeji 2, 400 ÷ 80 = nkeji 5; ya mere ọ bụ nkeji 2 ruo 5.
l-e-e6-b02-18.s.s2.model.0: Ịgụ ngwa ngwa na-ewe 400 ÷ 200 = nkeji 2; ịgụ nke ọma na-ewe 400 ÷ 80 = nkeji 5; ya mere ọ bụ nkeji 2 ruo 5.
l-e-e6-b02-18.s.s2.model.1: O ji ma ọsọ kacha ọsọ ma nke kacha nwayọọ; ya mere oge ya dị n’etiti nkeji 2 na nkeji 5.

l-e-e6-b02-19.title: Ọdịiche oge ụra site n’oge e tụrụ aro site na should
l-e-e6-b02-19.goal: Tụọ ọdịiche n’etiti awa 9 a tụrụ aro kwa ụbọchị na oge ụra i nwetara n’ezie, họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e6-b02-19.material: I kwesịrị ịrahụ ụra awa 9 kwa abalị. Ana m arahụ ụra awa 7 kwa abalị. Tụọ ole ụra m na-enweta kwa izu dị ntakịrị karịa oge a tụrụ aro.
l-e-e6-b02-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụ ọgụgụ ụra na-efu dabara adaba?
l-e-e6-b02-19.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ oge fọdụrụ n’otu ụbọchị, ọ bụghị n’ime otu izu.
l-e-e6-b02-19.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ oge ụra n’otu ụbọchị, ọ bụghị oge na-efu.
l-e-e6-b02-19.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ngụkọta oge a tụrụ aro maka izu ahụ dum.
l-e-e6-b02-19.s.s1.explain: Ụra na-erughị awa 2 kwa ụbọchị, 2 × 7 = awa 14.
l-e-e6-b02-19.s.s2.model.0: Kwa ụbọchị, 9−7=awa 2 na-efu; ya mere n’ime otu izu ọ bụ awa 14.
l-e-e6-b02-19.s.s2.model.1: Awa 2 na-agbakọta n’ime ụbọchị 7; ya mere ihe dị ka awa 14 na-efu.

l-e-e6-b02-20.title: Oge ole dị n’otu peeji ederede?
l-e-e6-b02-20.goal: Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ ntụpọ dị n’ederede okwu 150, họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e6-b02-20.material: Otu peeji ederede nwere okwu 150. Ahịrịokwu na-enwekarị ihe dị ka okwu 10, ahịrịokwu nke ọ bụla na-ejedebe na ntụpọ. Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ ntụpọ (.) dị.
l-e-e6-b02-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụ ọgụgụ ntụpọ dabara adaba?
l-e-e6-b02-20.s.s1.r.a: Ahịrịokwu 2 ga-abụ ihe dị ka okwu 20.
l-e-e6-b02-20.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụrụ na ahịrịokwu nke ọ bụla nwere naanị okwu 1.
l-e-e6-b02-20.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ karịrị ọnụ ọgụgụ okwu ahụ nke ukwuu.
l-e-e6-b02-20.s.s1.explain: 150 ÷ 10 = 15; ya mere e nwere ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 15 na ihe dị ka ntụpọ 15.
l-e-e6-b02-20.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrịokwu nke ọ bụla nwere okwu 10; ya mere 150 ÷ 10 na-enye ihe dị ka ntụpọ 15 kwa.
l-e-e6-b02-20.s.s2.model.1: E nwere otu ntụpọ n’ahịrịokwu nke ọ bụla; ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 15, otu ọnụ ọgụgụ ahịrịokwu.

l-e-e6-b03-16.goal: Tụọ ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede ukwu n'mmalite ahịrịokwu iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e6-b03-16.material: Akụkọ nwere peeji 3, na ahịrịokwu 8 n'peeji ọ bụla. Mkpụrụedemede mbụ nke ahịrịokwu ọ bụla bụ mkpụrụedemede ukwu. Tụọ ihe dị ka mkpụrụedemede ukwu ole na-amalite ahịrịokwu n'ozuzu.
l-e-e6-b03-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede ukwu ziri ezi?
l-e-e6-b03-16.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu n'otu peeji. Akụkọ bụ peeji 3.
l-e-e6-b03-16.s.s1.r.d: Ị tụrụ ihe dị ka ugboro 10 buru ibu nke ukwuu.
l-e-e6-b03-16.s.s1.explain: 8 × 3 = 24, ya mere e nwere ihe dị ka mkpụrụedemede ukwu 24 n'mmalite ahịrịokwu.
l-e-e6-b03-16.s.s2.model.0: E nwere 8 n'peeji 3 ọ bụla, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 24 site na 8 × 3.
l-e-e6-b03-16.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrịokwu ọ bụla nwere otu mkpụrụedemede ukwu, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 24, ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu.

l-e-e6-b03-17.material: Ederede ịgụ nwere okwu 400. N'ederede Bekee, ihe dị ka otu n'okwu 20 ọ bụla bụ the. Tụọ ihe dị ka ugboro ole the pụtara n'ederede a.
l-e-e6-b03-17.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ ugboro ziri ezi maka the?
l-e-e6-b03-17.s.s1.r.a: N'okwu 400, ọ na-apụta ugboro karịrị nke a.
l-e-e6-b03-17.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ otu n'okwu 5 ọ bụla.
l-e-e6-b03-17.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụrụ na ọkara nke okwu bụ the.
l-e-e6-b03-17.s.s1.explain: 400 ÷ 20 = 20, ya mere the na-apụta ihe dị ka ugboro 20.
l-e-e6-b03-17.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ ihe dị ka otu n'okwu 20 ọ bụla, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka ugboro 20 site na 400 ÷ 20.
l-e-e6-b03-17.s.s2.model.1: Okwu 400 nwere otu 20 nke okwu 20, ya mere the na-apụtakwa ihe dị ka ugboro 20.

l-e-e6-b03-19.goal: Tụọ oge ọ na-ewe ịzụ ide okwu iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e6-b03-19.material: Ị na-azụ site n'ide okwu ọhụrụ 12 nke ọ bụla ugboro 10. Ide otu ugboro na-ewe ihe dị ka sekọnd 5. Tụọ oge ọ na-ewe ide ha niile.
l-e-e6-b03-19.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ oge maka ide okwu ọ bụla naanị otu ugboro. Ọ kwesịrị ịbụ ugboro 10 nke ọ bụla.
l-e-e6-b03-19.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ oge ma ọ bụrụ na oge ọ bụla were sekọnd 30.
l-e-e6-b03-19.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ oge maka ide ihe dị ka ugboro 24. Ọ erughị ugboro 120.
l-e-e6-b03-19.s.s1.explain: 12 × 10 = ugboro 120 na 120 × 5 = sekọnd 600, nke bụ nkeji 10.
l-e-e6-b03-19.s.s2.model.0: Ọnụọgụ ugboro a ga-ede bụ 120 site na 12 × 10, ma na sekọnd 5 nke ọ bụla ọ bụ sekọnd 600, ihe dị ka nkeji 10.
l-e-e6-b03-19.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ ugboro 120 na sekọnd 5 nke ọ bụla, nke na-ewe sekọnd 600, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 10.

l-e-e6-b03-20.title: Oge ọrụ oge ịlakpu ụra na-akwụsị
l-e-e6-b03-20.goal: Tụọ oge ọrụ atọ na-akwụsị iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e6-b03-20.material: Ana m asa ezé m nkeji 3. Ana m asa ahụ nkeji 12. Ana m agụ akwụkwọ nkeji 20. Ana m amalite n'8:30. Tụọ oge atọ niile na-agwụ.
l-e-e6-b03-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu oge ziri ezi maka mgbe ha na-akwụsị?
l-e-e6-b03-20.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ oge mgbe agbakwunyere naanị nkeji 15. Nchikota nke oge atọ ahụ bụ nkeji 35.
l-e-e6-b03-20.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ oge mgbe agbakwunyere awa 1 na ọkara. Nchikota bụ nkeji 35.
l-e-e6-b03-20.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ oge mgbe agbakwunyere otu awa. Nchikota bụ nkeji 35.
l-e-e6-b03-20.s.s1.explain: 3 + 12 + 20 = nkeji 35, ya mere nkeji 35 mgbe 8:30 bụ nkeji 5 mgbe 9, nke bụ ihe dị ka elekere 9.
l-e-e6-b03-20.s.s2.model.0: Nchikota nke ọrụ atọ ahụ bụ 3 + 12 + 20, nke bụ nkeji 35, ya mere ịgbakwunye ya n'8:30 na-enye ihe dị ka elekere 9.
l-e-e6-b03-20.s.s2.model.1: Nkeji 35 erughị otu awa, ya mere ha na-akwụsị n'ihe dị ka elekere 9, ọ bụghị 9:30.

l-e-e6-b04-16.title: Ọnwa ole iji gụchaa akwụkwọ ọbá akwụkwọ niile
l-e-e6-b04-16.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ogologo oge ọ na-ewe klaasị niile iji gụọ akwụkwọ 600, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe akaebe.
l-e-e6-b04-16.material: E nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ 28 n'klaasị, onye ọ bụla na-agụ akwụkwọ dị iche 2 n'ọnwa. Ọbá akwụkwọ klaasị nwere akwụkwọ 600. Tụọ atụmatụ ihe dị ka ọnwa ole ọ na-ewe iji gụchaa ha niile.
l-e-e6-b04-16.s.s1.r.a: Nke a dị nso n'ọsọ nke ịgụ akwụkwọ 600 n'otu ọnwa. N'otu ọnwa, ọ bụ ihe dị ka akwụkwọ 56.
l-e-e6-b04-16.s.s1.r.c: A were ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ, 28, dịka ọnụọgụ ọnwa.
l-e-e6-b04-16.s.s1.r.d: A tụrụ atụmatụ n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi dịka ihe dị ka akwụkwọ 6 n'ọnwa.
l-e-e6-b04-16.s.s1.explain: Ha na-agụ ihe dị ka akwụkwọ 56 n'ọnwa (28 × 2). 600 ÷ 56 bụ ihe dị ka 10.7, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka ọnwa 11.
l-e-e6-b04-16.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbaa 28 gburugburu ruo 30, ọ bụ ihe dị ka akwụkwọ 60 n'ọnwa, ma 600 ÷ 60 = 10, ya mere ihe dị ka ọnwa 11 kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-e6-b04-16.s.s2.model.1: Ha na-agụ ihe dị ka akwụkwọ 56 n'ọnwa, ya mere ikewa 600 na-enye ntakịrị karịa ọnwa 10, ihe dị ka ọnwa 11.

l-e-e6-b04-17.title: Izu ole iji ruo ọnụọgụ okwu ebumnuche
l-e-e6-b04-17.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ izu achọrọ iji ruo okwu 200, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe akaebe.
l-e-e6-b04-17.material: Ị maara okwu 135 ugbu a. Ị na-eme atụmatụ icheta okwu ọhụrụ 12 kwa izu iji ruo 200. Tụọ atụmatụ ihe dị ka izu ole ọ ga-ewe.
l-e-e6-b04-17.s.s1.r.a: E gbakọrọ 200 ÷ 12. Ị ghaghị iwepụ 135 ị maralarị.
l-e-e6-b04-17.s.s1.r.c: A were 12 dịka ọnụọgụ izu. Okwu ndị ka achọrọ bụ ihe dị ka 65.
l-e-e6-b04-17.s.s1.r.d: Okwu 12 n'izu 1 dị mkpụmkpụ nke ukwuu karịa 200.
l-e-e6-b04-17.s.s1.explain: Okwu fọdụrụ icheta bụ 200 − 135 = 65. 65 ÷ 12 dị n'etiti 5 na 6, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka izu 5 ruo 6.
l-e-e6-b04-17.s.s2.model.0: Ị chọrọ okwu 65 ọzọ ma na-amụta 12 n'izu, ya mere ihe dị ka izu 5 ruo 6 kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-e6-b04-17.s.s2.model.1: Ịkewa 65 site na 12 na-enye ihe dị ka 5.4, ya mere ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka izu 5 ruo 6, ị ghaghịkwa iwepụ okwu ị maralarị.

l-e-e6-b04-18.title: Ịtụ atụmatụ ngụkọta oge nke nzọụkwụ isi nri
l-e-e6-b04-18.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ oge iji mezue nzọụkwụ atọ niile, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe akaebe.
l-e-e6-b04-18.material: Ederede isi nri: First, mix for 8 minutes. Then, bake for 25 minutes. Finally, cool for 12 minutes. Ihe dị ka ogologo oge ole ka ọ na-ewe iji mezue ihe niile?
l-e-e6-b04-18.s.s1.r.a: A gụrụ naanị oge ime achịcha. Ị ghaghị ịgbakwunye nzọụkwụ atọ niile.
l-e-e6-b04-18.s.s1.r.c: Ọ dị ogologo nke ukwuu. 8 + 25 + 12 dị ntakịrị karịa 50.
l-e-e6-b04-18.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ ihe dị ka nchikota nke ịgwakọta na ime jụụ naanị. Oge ime achịcha na-efu.
l-e-e6-b04-18.s.s1.explain: 8 + 25 + 12 = nkeji 45. Ịgbakwunye oge nke nzọụkwụ atọ niile na-enye ihe dị ka nkeji 45.
l-e-e6-b04-18.s.s2.model.0: Ọbụlagodi na ị gbaa 8 gburugburu ruo 10, 12 ruo 10, ma debe 25 dịka 25, ọ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 45, ya mere ọ bụ nchikota nke nzọụkwụ atọ niile.
l-e-e6-b04-18.s.s2.model.1: Ịgwakọta nkeji 8, ime achịcha nkeji 25, na ime jụụ nkeji 12 na-agbakwunye ruo nkeji 45, ya mere ihe dị ka nkeji 45 kwesịrị ekwesị.

l-e-e6-b04-19.title: Ịtụ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ okwu nke ederede niile
l-e-e6-b04-19.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ okwu n'ederede nwere paragraf 4, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe akaebe.
l-e-e6-b04-19.material: Ederede nwere paragraf 4, paragraf ọ bụla nwekwara ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 5. Otu ahịrịokwu nwere ihe dị ka okwu 9 n'nkezi. Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ okwu nke ederede niile.
l-e-e6-b04-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ngụkọta ọnụọgụ okwu kwesịrị ekwesị?
l-e-e6-b04-19.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ ọnụọgụ okwu n'otu paragraf. E nwere paragraf 4.
l-e-e6-b04-19.s.s1.r.c: A chọtara naanị ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu (4 × 5). Ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ okwu.
l-e-e6-b04-19.s.s1.r.d: Ọ buru ibu otu place value. 4 × 5 × 9 dị ntakịrị karịa 200.
l-e-e6-b04-19.s.s1.explain: 4 × 5 = ahịrịokwu 20, ma 20 × 9 = okwu 180. Ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka okwu 180.
l-e-e6-b04-19.s.s2.model.0: Paragraf 4 nwere ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 20, otu ahịrịokwu nwekwara ihe dị ka okwu 9, ya mere ihe dị ka okwu 180 kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-e6-b04-19.s.s2.model.1: Na okwu 9 n'ahịrịokwu 20 ọ bụla ọ na-erute ihe dị ka 180, ya mere nhọrọ ndị ọzọ dị ntakịrị ma ọ bụ buru ibu nke ukwuu.

l-e-e6-b04-20.topic: Ịtụ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ntinye akwụkwọ okwu
l-e-e6-b04-20.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ntinye n'akwụkwọ okwu nwere peeji 480, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe akaebe.
l-e-e6-b04-20.material: E nwere akwụkwọ okwu bekee nwere peeji 480, peeji ọ bụla nwekwara ihe dị ka ntinye okwu 25. Tụọ atụmatụ ihe dị ka ntinye ole akwụkwọ okwu a nwere n'ozuzu.
l-e-e6-b04-20.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ ọnụọgụ dị nso n'ọnụọgụ peeji. E nwere 25 n'peeji ọ bụla.
l-e-e6-b04-20.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ihe dị ka ọnụọgụ peeji e mịkọrịtara site na 2.5. Ị ghaghị ịmịkọrịta site na 25.
l-e-e6-b04-20.s.s1.r.d: Ọ buru ibu otu place value. 500 × 25 bụ ihe dị ka 12,500.
l-e-e6-b04-20.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị were 480 dịka 500, 500 × 25 bụ ihe dị ka 12,500. Kpọmkwem, 480 × 25 = ntinye 12,000.
l-e-e6-b04-20.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị mịkọrịta 480 dịka 500 site na 25, ọ bụ ihe dị ka 12,500, ya mere ihe dị ka ntinye 12,000 kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-e6-b04-20.s.s2.model.1: Peeji ọ bụla nwere ntinye 25 ma e nwere peeji 480, ya mere 480 × 25 = 12,000, uru nwere ọnụọgụ digit ziri ezi bụkwa ihe dị ka ntinye 12,000.

l-e-e6-b05-16.goal: Tụọ anya ọnụọgụ okwu niile e dere n'akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi 24 iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e6-b05-16.material: Ndị klaasị na-eme akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi 24. Akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi ọ bụla nwere ihe dị ka ahịrị okwu 5, ma ahịrị okwu ọ bụla nwere ihe dị ka okwu 8. Tụọ anya ọnụọgụ okwu niile.
l-e-e6-b05-16.s.s1.r.b: Ọ karịrị ntakịrị ọnụọgụ okwu dị n'otu akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi (40).
l-e-e6-b05-16.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ ihe dị ka 24 × 8. Ahịrị okwu 5 ejighị mụbaa.
l-e-e6-b05-16.s.s1.r.d: Ọ nwere otu ọnụọgụ dị ukwuu nke ukwuu. 24 × 40 bụ ihe dị ka 1,000.
l-e-e6-b05-16.s.s1.explain: Otu akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi nwere ihe dị ka 5 × 8 = okwu 40, ma akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi 24 nwere ihe dị ka okwu 960, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka okwu 1,000.
l-e-e6-b05-16.s.s2.model.0: Otu akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi nwere ihe dị ka okwu 40, ma ịmụba site na 24 na-enye ihe dị ka 960, ya mere ihe dị ka okwu 1,000 bụ azịza ziri ezi.
l-e-e6-b05-16.s.s2.model.1: 5 × 8 na-enye ihe dị ka okwu 40 n'akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi ọ bụla, ma ịmụba site na 24 na-enye ihe dị ka 1,000, ya mere ọ bụ uru nwere ọnụọgụ ọnụọgụ ziri ezi.

l-e-e6-b02-22.material: Nke a bụ usoro ọrụ chọtara ihe “If it snows tomorrow, we will build a snowman.” pụtara. ① if na-ekwu maka ihe nwere ike ime ma ọ bụ ghara ime ② Ọ pụtara na ọ bụrụ na snow zoo, anyị ga-eme snowman ③ Ya mere snow ezoola ④ Azịza: Snow zoro, ya mere anyị mere snowman

l-e-e6-b02-22.s.s1.o.d: ④ Azịza: Snow zoro, ya mere anyị mere otu

l-e-e6-b02-23.title: Usoro ọrụ nke zara ajụjụ ikike
l-e-e6-b02-23.goal: Soro usoro ọrụ maka ịza Can I open the window?, chọta ebe mbụ o si mehie ma dozie ya.
l-e-e6-b02-23.material: Nwa akwụkwọ jụrụ onye nkuzi, “Can I open the window?” Nke a bụ usoro ọrụ e ji kpebie azịza onye nkuzi. ① Can I ~? bụ ụzọ isi rịọ ikike ② Onye jụrụ bụ nwa akwụkwọ, onye zara bụ onye nkuzi ③ Jirikwa I n’azịza: Yes, I can. ④ Azịza: Yes, I can.
l-e-e6-b02-23.s.s1.r.a: Can I ~? bụ ụzọ isi rịọ ikike; ya mere nke ahụ ziri ezi.
l-e-e6-b02-23.s.s1.o.b: ② Onye jụrụ bụ nwa akwụkwọ
l-e-e6-b02-23.s.s1.r.b: Ọ mataziri onye jụrụ na onye zara nke ọma.
l-e-e6-b02-23.s.s1.o.c: ③ Jirikwa I n’azịza: Yes, I can.
l-e-e6-b02-23.s.s1.explain: Onye nkuzi zara na-enye nwa akwụkwọ (you) ikike. Yes, you can. ziri ezi.
l-e-e6-b02-23.s.s2.model.0: Onye zara na-akpọ onye jụrụ you; ya mere a ga-edozi ③ ka ọ bụrụ Yes, you can.
l-e-e6-b02-23.s.s2.model.1: I pụtara onye na-ekwu okwu n’onwe ya; ya mere mgbe onye nkuzi na-ekwu, a na-akpọ nwa akwụkwọ ahụ you.

l-e-e6-b02-25.s.s1.r.a: Ọ gụrụ ahịrị mbụ nke akara ahụ nke ọma.
l-e-e6-b02-25.s.s1.o.b: ② Elekere 10 dị n’ime oge ahụ
l-e-e6-b02-25.s.s1.r.b: Elekere 10 dị n’etiti 9 na 5; ya mere nke ahụ ziri ezi.

l-e-e6-b02-25.s.s1.explain: Ọ na-ekwu Closed on Sundays, ya mere ọ na-emechi na Sunday. Azịza ya bụ na ị gaghị azụta ihe ọ bụla.

l-e-e6-b03-21.title: Ebe nkọwa nke ihe spotless pụtara na-agabiga ụzọ?
l-e-e6-b03-21.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ site n'nzọụkwụ nkọwa (ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ) maka ichepụta ihe spotless pụtara, chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ, ma dozie ya.
l-e-e6-b03-21.material: The room was spotless. Everything was clean. Nkọwa: ① Ihe ngosi gburugburu okwu: Everything was clean ② spot pụtara akara adịghị ọcha ③ -less pụtara 'n'enweghị' ④ Ya mere spotless pụtara inwe ọtụtụ akara adịghị ọcha
l-e-e6-b03-21.s.s1.o.a: ① Ihe ngosi: Everything was clean
l-e-e6-b03-21.s.s1.r.a: Ọ ziri ezi n'ihi na ihe ngosi na-ekwu na ihe niile dị ọcha.
l-e-e6-b03-21.s.s1.o.b: ② spot pụtara akara adịghị ọcha
l-e-e6-b03-21.s.s1.r.b: Ọ ziri ezi n'ihi na spot pụtara akara adịghị ọcha.
l-e-e6-b03-21.s.s1.r.c: Ọ ziri ezi n'ihi na -less pụtara 'n'enweghị'.
l-e-e6-b03-21.s.s1.o.d: ④ inwe ọtụtụ akara adịghị ọcha
l-e-e6-b03-21.s.s1.explain: Ịtinye spot (akara adịghị ọcha) na -less (n'enweghị) ọnụ na-enye inwe akara adịghị ọcha ọ bụla, dị ọcha nke ukwuu.
l-e-e6-b03-21.s.s2.model.0: -less pụtara 'n'enweghị', ya mere ④ kwesịrị idozi ka ọ kwuo na enweghị akara adịghị ọcha.
l-e-e6-b03-21.s.s2.model.1: ④ ezighị ezi n'ihi na ọ dabaghị n'ihe ngosi clean, ma spotless pụtara dị ọcha n'enweghị otu akara adịghị ọcha.

l-e-e6-b06-25.s.s1.o.d: ④ Emechara: My dog haves a ball.
l-e-e6-b06-25.s.s1.explain: Have anaghị ewere -s kama ọ na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ has. Ya mere My dog has a ball. ziri ezi.

l-e-e6-b04-34.title: Ụzọ abụọ isi họpụta ahịrịokwu oge gara aga
l-e-e6-b04-34.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ maka ịmata ma ahịrịokwu bụ banyere ihe n'oge gara aga, họrọ nke ka mma, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara gị.
l-e-e6-b04-34.material: Ndị a bụ ụzọ abụọ isi mata ma ahịrịokwu bụ banyere oge gara aga. A: Lelee naanị ma verb na-agwụ na -ed. B: Lelee okwu oge dị ka yesterday na udi verb (gụnyere ndị na-agbanwe dị ka went).
l-e-e6-b04-34.s.s1.o.a: A: Na-enweghị -ed, ọ bụghị banyere oge gara aga
l-e-e6-b04-34.s.s1.r.a: E nwere udi oge gara aga dị ka went nke na-agbanwe n'enweghị -ed.
l-e-e6-b04-34.s.s1.o.b: B: Lelee okwu oge na udi e gbanwere kwa
l-e-e6-b04-34.s.s1.r.c: A na-ahapụ udi oge gara aga dị ka went na saw.
l-e-e6-b04-34.s.s1.r.d: B na-ele ihe ngosi ọnụ, ya mere ọ bụ nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi.
l-e-e6-b04-34.s.s1.explain: Udi oge gara aga abụghị naanị -ed; ụfọdụ na-agbanwe dị ka went na saw. Ilele okwu oge kwa bụ nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi karịa.
l-e-e6-b04-34.s.s2.model.0: E nwere oge gara aga n'enweghị -ed dị ka went, ya mere B, nke na-ele okwu oge na udi ọnụ, ka mma.

l-e-e6-b04-35.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara nke helping verb dabara ndụmọdụ, họrọ nke ka mma, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara gị.
l-e-e6-b04-35.material: Enyi gị nwere obere oyi. A: You must stay in bed for a month. B: You should rest and drink water.
l-e-e6-b04-35.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke bụ ndụmọdụ ka mma maka enyi, ma gịnị mere?

l-e-e6-b04-35.s.s1.r.a: Ịgwa mmadụ ka ọ nọrọ n'ihe ndina otu ọnwa dị ukwuu nke ukwuu maka obere oyi.
l-e-e6-b04-35.s.s1.o.b: B: should bụ ndụmọdụ kwesịrị ekwesị
l-e-e6-b04-35.s.s1.r.c: A siri ike dị ka iwu, ya mere ọ dabaghị n'oyi dị nro.
l-e-e6-b04-35.s.s1.r.d: B bụ ndụmọdụ kwesịrị ekwesị iji zuru ike ma ṅụọ mmiri.
l-e-e6-b04-35.s.s1.explain: Jiri should maka ndụmọdụ ị na-atụ aro ma must maka ihe ị ga-eme n'ezie. Maka oyi dị nro, ndụmọdụ izu ike na ịṅụ mmiri kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-e6-b04-35.s.s2.model.0: Maka oyi dị nro, should, nke na-atụ aro izu ike na ịṅụ mmiri, kwesịrị ekwesị, ya mere B bụ ndụmọdụ ka mma.

l-e-e6-b05-31.title: Ahịrịokwu abụọ chịkọtara ederede banyere mbe
l-e-e6-b05-31.goal: Tụlee ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta nke chịkọtara ederede gbasara mbe, họrọ nke kacha daba adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e6-b05-31.material: Ederede: Mbe na-eji nwayọọ aga ma sie ike. Akpụkpọ ya siri ike na-echebe ya. Mbe nwere ike ịdị ndụ ọtụtụ afọ. Tụlee ahịrịokwu abụọ chịkọtara ya. A: Mbe na-eji nwayọọ aga. B: Mbe na-eji nwayọọ aga, ma akpụkpọ ya na-echebe ya, ọ na-adịkwa ndụ ogologo oge.
l-e-e6-b05-31.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke chịkọtara ederede ahụ nke ọma, gịnịkwa mere?
l-e-e6-b05-31.s.s1.o.a: A: Ọ dị mkpirikpi, ya mere ọ zuru dịka nchịkọta
l-e-e6-b05-31.s.s1.r.a: Ọ kwuru naanị otu ihe; ya mere ọdịnaya dị mkpa nke ederede adịghị.
l-e-e6-b05-31.s.s1.o.b: B: O nwere ọdịnaya dị mkpa n’akụkụ niile
l-e-e6-b05-31.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ chịkọtara ya nke ọma otu.
l-e-e6-b05-31.s.s1.r.c: A enweghị okwu gbasara akpụkpọ ahụ ma ọ bụ ịdị ndụ ogologo oge.
l-e-e6-b05-31.s.s1.r.d: B chịkọtara ọdịnaya dị mkpa nke ederede ahụ.
l-e-e6-b05-31.s.s1.explain: Nchịkọta dị mma na-eme ka ederede dị mkpirikpi n’enweghị ịhapụ ọdịnaya dị mkpa. B gụnyere nwayọọ, akpụkpọ ahụ na ndụ ogologo.
l-e-e6-b05-31.s.s2.model.0: B tinyere isi ihe atọ dị mkpa nke ederede ahụ nkenke, ya mere ọ chịkọtara ya nke ọma karịa A.
l-e-e6-b05-31.s.s2.model.1: A nwere naanị otu isi ihe, bụ ịdị nwayọọ, ya mere ọdịnaya dị mkpa na-efu, B dabakwara nke ọma.

l-e-e6-b05-33.topic: Ịchọta ihe okwu pụtara site na ọnọdụ ya
l-e-e6-b05-33.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ihe narrow pụtara, họrọ nke dabara adaba karịa, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e6-b05-33.material: Ederede: The road was narrow, so only one car could pass. Mina says narrow means 'wide', and Jun says narrow means 'not wide'.

l-e-e6-b05-33.s.s1.r.c: Ihe abụọ ahụ pụtara bụ ihe megidere ibe ha, ya mere ha abụọ enweghị ike ịbụ ihe ziri ezi.

l-e-e6-b05-33.s.s1.r.d: Ederede ahụ nwere ihe ngosi, naanị otu ụgbọ ala nwere ike ịgafe.
l-e-e6-b05-33.s.s1.explain: Naanị otu ụgbọ ala nwere ike ịgafe, ya mere ụzọ ahụ sara mbara adịghị. Ọ bụrụ na ị lelee ihe dị tupu so na ihe na-esote ya, ị nwere ike iche ihe ọ pụtara.

l-e-e6-b05-34.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe ihe akaebe dị nke ị nwere ike ịhụ ugbu a, kedu nke bụ nke na-adị mma karịa, gịnịkwa mere?

l-e-e6-b05-34.s.s1.r.a: A na-ejikarị will maka echiche na-enweghị ihe akaebe ma ọ bụ mkpebi e mere ozugbo.
l-e-e6-b05-34.s.s1.o.b: B: be going to na-eche echiche site n'ihe akaebe dị n'ihu gị
l-e-e6-b05-34.s.s1.o.c: A na-eji ha abụọ n'otu ụzọ ahụ kpamkpam
l-e-e6-b05-34.s.s1.r.c: Mgbe ihe akaebe dị n'ihu gị, be going to na-adị mma karịa.

l-e-e6-b05-34.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ihe akaebe dị n'ihu gị nke ị nwere ike ịhụ (igwe ojii gbara ọchịchịrị), ọ na-adị mma karịa ikwu ya site na be going to.
